description: POST /replace_clock_dial_bg using multipart (Device/ReplaceClockDialBgFile). Replaces the cached dial bitmap only — does NOT modify cfg DeviceImageUrl, and does NOT accept tar.gz. Backdrop is validated by divoom_watchface_replace_clock_dial_bg_validate_saved_file: JPEG (FF D8) or WebP (RIFF…WEBP) only, ≤ 500 KiB (DIVOOM_REPLACE_DIAL_BG_MAX_FILE_BYTES), recommended 800x1280 portrait. Multipart framing notes: watchface_upload_file description.

fileName.description: Filename in multipart header. Defaults to basename(imagePath).

filePartName.description: Second multipart part name. Default is current UTC ms timestamp.

imagePath.description: Absolute or relative image file path. Backdrop must be JPEG (FF D8) or WebP (RIFF…WEBP); PNG/GIF are rejected. Recommended 800x1280, ≤ 500 KiB.

target.description: Optional per-call target override. If omitted, environment variables are used.

name: watchface_replace_dial_bg_file
